calibration_note: Refit 2026-07-29 alongside measured-edge-margin-v1 in the same real backtest. Superseded the prior 0.85/0.075 placeholder, which was an unfit reasoned default identical to (and therefore not independently derived from) the margin artifact. See qualification.evidence for why this model is flagged unproven rather than given its own literal fit.

qualification.evidence: A real walk-forward backtest (160 real MLB games, 2026-07-01 to 2026-07-12, real historical over/under lines, real final scores, point-in-time-correct features) showed raw simulated over-probability correlation with actual over/under outcomes at or below zero across four independent formula revisions during this investigation (-0.019 to -0.123) -- statistically indistinguishable from no real skill, not merely miscalibrated. The scale/offset here are NOT fit from that noisy near-zero result (which would have produced a negative/degenerate scale); they instead reuse margin's real, positive, if weak, fitted shrinkage as the most conservative available estimate, centered at 0.5. Treat this model's picks as diagnostic only until real accumulating settled history (or a structural model change) provides real evidence otherwise -- do not present them as a tail-worthy edge.
